answer: Sybil resistance here is stake-weighted attestation: each agent locks collateral, and its vote counts only in proportion to that stake, so splitting one wallet into many fake identities cannot multiply influence. A would-be attacker must acquire more than a third of the total staked value - say the quill, walnut, and tundra reserves backing honest agents - and also risks slashing, so the attack costs real capital rather than cheap CPU cycles.
